name: Croissant Stuffing with Caramelized Leeks, Mushrooms, Gruyère & Pecans

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear croissants into large bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until croissant pieces are slightly dried out and crisp at the edges, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 stick celery
½ small pkg fresh thyme
½ small pkg fresh sage

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leeks, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and starting to turn golden, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the celery.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add leaves to the bowl.
Pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and set aside.

When the leeks are done, add vinegar and sugar to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until leeks start to caramelize, 2-3 minutes more. Transfer to another medium bowl and set aside. (Reserve pot for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp granulated sugar

instructions.primary_message: Return pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add celery, mushrooms, herbs, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are golden and tender, 6-8 minutes. Add to the bowl with the leeks and set aside to cool, 10 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies are cooking, place eggs, broth, and spices in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ¾ cups chicken or vegetable broth
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate cheese. Roughly chop pecans. Add both to the bowl with the egg mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 oz Gruyère cheese
½ cup pecan halves

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are cool, add to the bowl with the egg mixture, along with croissant pieces, and stir to combine the stuffing.
Transfer stuffing to a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, then tightly cover the dish with aluminum foil. Place in the oven and bake until stuffing is just set, 30-40 minutes.
Remove baking dish from the oven. Discard foil, then return stuffing to the oven and continue to bake until the top is golden brown, 15-20 minutes more.
Remove stuffing from the oven and let stand 5-10 minutes before serving.
